items.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent prototype coding agent
facts: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request.
Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.316 adds subagent effort control and deprecates Opus 4.8 fast mode
facts: Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's.
Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK, which turns the ultrathink keyword off.
Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026.

items.title: OpenAI to share ChatGPT and Codex usage allowance starting in December
facts: Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans' usage allowance will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex as we bring the agentic capabilities of Work into the main ChatGPT experience.
Your usage for ChatGPT and Codex will be measured in tokens. Instant chat will not draw from your usage.
You will be able to see your combined remaining usage and reset times in Settings → Usage.

items.title: Google winds down Jules AI coding agent, folding learnings into Antigravity
facts: Jules will be winding down. We're working on bringing our learnings from Jules into Antigravity so you get the best of both worlds: autonomous remote background task execution and an agent-first development environment.
Users have until November 11, 2026 to finish active sessions, after which Jules becomes read-only until the full shutdown on December 31, 2026.

items.title: Antigravity launches Plugin Marketplace for skills, MCP, rules and subagents
facts: Today, we are launching the Plugin Marketplace in Antigravity, a centralized directory for discovering and installing third-party and Google-built plugins across the Antigravity App and the Antigravity CLI.
An Antigravity plugin is a versioned, self-contained bundle defined by a plugin.json manifest that packages up to five extensibility primitives: skills, MCP servers, rules, hooks and custom agents.
